def get_face_prod(q, local_axis, target_axis):
    """
    get product of local_axis (under q world) and target_axis
    """
    q_mat = t3d.quaternions.quat2mat(q)

    return face_prod

"""Generate and verify the frozen scan_object trajectory."""
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import transforms3d as t3d

from rcb_traj import Session


INSTANCE = "/app/instance.json"
OUT = "/app/output/trajectory.npz"


def pose_matrix(pose):
    return t3d.affines.compose(
        np.asarray(pose[:3], dtype=float),
        t3d.quaternions.quat2mat(np.asarray(pose[3:], dtype=float)),
        np.ones(3),
    )


def matrix_pose(matrix):
    return np.r_[matrix[:3, 3], t3d.quaternions.mat2quat(matrix[:3, :3])]


def main():
    s = Session("scan_object", instance=INSTANCE)
    env = s.env
